import re
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches, Cm
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_UNDERLINE
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

RED = RGBColor(0xC0, 0x00, 0x00)
BLUE = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x4E, 0xB4)
NAVY = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x2A, 0x44)
GREY = RGBColor(0x55, 0x55, 0x55)
RATING_FILL = {"Critical": "C00000", "High": "ED7D31", "Medium": "FFC000", "Low": "70AD47", "OK": "A9D08E"}
RATING_FONT = {"Critical": "FFFFFF", "High": "FFFFFF", "Medium": "000000", "Low": "FFFFFF", "OK": "000000"}

TOKEN = re.compile(r"(\[-.*?-\]|\{\+.*?\+\}|\*\*.*?\*\*|__.*?__)", re.S)

def add_runs(p, text, size=None, color=None, italic=False, bold=False):
    for part in TOKEN.split(text):
        if not part:
            continue
        if part.startswith("[-") and part.endswith("-]"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.font.strike = True; r.font.color.rgb = RED
        elif part.startswith("{+") and part.endswith("+}"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.font.underline = WD_UNDERLINE.DOUBLE; r.font.color.rgb = BLUE
        elif part.startswith("**") and part.endswith("**"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.bold = True
            if color: r.font.color.rgb = color
        elif part.startswith("__") and part.endswith("__"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.italic = True
            if color: r.font.color.rgb = color
        else:
            r = p.add_run(part)
            if color: r.font.color.rgb = color
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if italic: r.italic = True
        if bold: r.bold = True
    return p

def shade(cell, hexfill):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd"); shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexfill)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def set_cell(cell, text, bold=False, size=9, fill=None, fontcolor=None, align=None):
    cell.text = ""
    paras = text.split("\n")
    for i, t in enumerate(paras):
        p = cell.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else cell.add_paragraph()
        p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
        p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
        if align: p.alignment = align
        add_runs(p, t, size=size, bold=bold, color=RGBColor.from_string(fontcolor) if fontcolor else None)
    if fill: shade(cell, fill)

def set_col_widths(table, widths):
    tbl = table._tbl
    grid = tbl.tblGrid
    for i, gc in enumerate(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol"))):
        if i < len(widths): gc.set(qn("w:w"), str(int(widths[i].twips if hasattr(widths[i], "twips") else widths[i])))
    for row in table.rows:
        for i, c in enumerate(row.cells):
            if i < len(widths):
                c.width = widths[i]

def repeat_header(row):
    trPr = row._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    el = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); el.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(el)

def table(doc, headers, rows, widths, header_fill="1F2A44", size=8.5, rating_col=None):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, h in enumerate(headers):
        set_cell(t.rows[0].cells[i], h, bold=True, size=size, fill=header_fill, fontcolor="FFFFFF")
    repeat_header(t.rows[0])
    for r in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, v in enumerate(r):
            if rating_col is not None and i == rating_col and v in RATING_FILL:
                set_cell(cells[i], v, bold=True, size=size, fill=RATING_FILL[v], fontcolor=RATING_FONT[v], align=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER)
            else:
                set_cell(cells[i], v, size=size)
    set_col_widths(t, widths)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def para(doc, text, size=10.5, style=None, italic=False, indent=None, space_after=6, align=None, color=None, bold=False):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style) if style else doc.add_paragraph()
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    if indent is not None: p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    if align: p.alignment = align
    add_runs(p, text, size=size, italic=italic, color=color, bold=bold)
    return p

def bullet(doc, text, level=0, size=10.5):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    add_runs(p, text, size=size)
    return p

def numbered(doc, text, size=10.5):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Number")
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    add_runs(p, text, size=size)
    return p

def heading(doc, text, level):
    h = doc.add_heading(text, level=level)
    for r in h.runs:
        r.font.color.rgb = NAVY
    return h

def redline_box(doc, label, text, fill="F2F5FA"):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=1)
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    c = t.rows[0].cells[0]
    c.text = ""
    p = c.paragraphs[0]
    add_runs(p, "**" + label + "**", size=9, color=NAVY)
    for block in text.split("\n\n"):
        q = c.add_paragraph(); q.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
        add_runs(q, block, size=9.5)
    shade(c, fill)
    set_col_widths(t, [Inches(6.5)])
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)

def add_page_number(paragraph):
    run = paragraph.add_run()
    f1 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f1.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "begin")
    it = OxmlElement("w:instrText"); it.set(qn("xml:space"), "preserve"); it.text = "PAGE"
    f2 = OxmlElement("w:fldChar"); f2.set(qn("w:fldCharType"), "end")
    run._r.append(f1); run._r.append(it); run._r.append(f2)
    run.font.size = Pt(8)
